import paramiko

# Check current commit
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git log -1 --oneline 2>&1")

# Check logs for any new errors
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 logs areloria --err --lines 20 --nostream 2>&1 | tail -15")
print("\nErrors:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
